lessons_used: Predictions frequently overestimated positive impact overall, but underestimated strong wins in rounds 3, 4, and 6.
home wait_info changes are often helpful, backed by 4 winning tests (rounds 3, 4, 7, and 9), though 4 tests showed no clear effect.
sign_in hint changes can be helpful, backed by 2 winning tests (rounds 4 and 6), though 6 tests showed no clear effect.
sign_in reorder changes proved consistently harmful, leading to a rollback in round 3 and a negative result in round 9.
choose_path layout changes and home notification changes consistently showed no clear effect across 2 agreeing tests each.

Evidence remains thin or inconsistent for adoption redesign, finish new_flow, finish new_screen, choose_path copy, choose_path redesign, and all single-test categories due to mixed results or insufficient tests.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Controls Quick Reference Screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated quick-reference screen before home intro showing visual callouts for how to hide, summon, and right-click control the desktop pet.
candidates.why: Support received multiple emails (3 emails) from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after completing setup.

new_desktop_controls_summary.headline: Mastering Your Desktop Companion
new_desktop_controls_summary.body: Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open quick actions, mute sound, or minimize to the system tray.

guard.reason: Adding a controls quick reference screen inside onboarding is allowed and preserves all required steps.

candidates.score_note: Adding a new screen in finish step has performed negatively (-2.9% avg) in past tests.

candidates.title: Account Recovery Guidance Screen
candidates.change: Add an account data recovery informational screen directly prior to sign in, explaining how existing pets and save data are restored when signing in.
candidates.why: The top support theme (8 emails) is users reporting missing or reset pets after signing in again.

new_account_recovery_guide.headline: Signing In Keeps Your Pets Safe
new_account_recovery_guide.body: Log into your existing account to automatically sync and restore all previously created desktop pets and progress.

guard.reason: screen 'new_account_recovery_guide' is not part of onboarding (new screens are named new_..., and may not look like payment, account, sign-up or settings screens)

candidates.title: Interactive Personality Trait Adoption Sub-Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a interactive trait selection step during adoption where users choose their pet's core temperament before generating the adoption certificate.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 66.2% with long median times (89s); increasing engagement during pet setup helps commitment.

new_personality_step.headline: Choose Your Pet's Personality
new_personality_step.body: Select how your desktop pet behaves during your workday.

guard.reason: Adding a trait selection sub-flow during adoption is permitted inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high drop-off, but adding a new sub-flow previously resulted in a -6.9% lift.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Visual Preview Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate layout into a centered spotlight view with animated pet rendering previews and custom pet validation status.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet rendering failures or visual glitches during adoption, and adoption overall drops significantly to 66.2%.

adoption_certificate.headline: Your Companion is Ready to Adopt!
adoption_certificate.body: Verify your pet's appearance and name before finalizing your adoption certificate.

guard.reason: 'adoption_certificate.replace.certificate[1]': a name_input cannot do the certificate job (use ['animation', 'badge', 'image', 'preview', 'text'])

candidates.title: Render Waiting Interactive Teaser Stage
candidates.change: Redesign the render waiting screen into an interactive preview stage featuring live mascot animations and companion tips while the desktop pet builds.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a high median duration (201s / mean 2336s); past test lessons demonstrate home wait info improvements drive consistent conversion wins.

waiting.headline: Bringing Your Desktop Pet to Life...
waiting.body: Our engine is rendering your pet's desktop physics and animations.

wait_status.text: Tip: Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime on your desktop to summon your pet!

guard.reason: replacement for 'waiting.wait_status' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['preview', 'progress', 'timer']

candidates.title: Existing Pet Account Sync Safety Hint
candidates.change: Add a clear hint on the sign-in screen assuring returning users that signing in syncs existing pet saves across desktop devices.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets when signing back into accounts.

sign_in.hint: Signing in automatically syncs your saved pets and progress from cloud backup.

guard.reason: Adding a sync hint on the sign-in screen is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 8 support emails; sign_in hints have a proven track record (+1.6% avg).

candidates.title: Desktop Render Ready System Notification
candidates.change: Enable desktop system completion notification prompts on the render waiting screen so users can minimize the app while waiting.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes a mean of 2336s (38 minutes); notifying users when generation completes prevents drop-off during long renders.

waiting.hint: Feel free to work on other tasks; we will alert you as soon as your pet lands on your desktop!

guard.reason: Enabling desktop notification prompts on the waiting screen is a valid onboarding enhancement.

candidates.score_note: Home notifications consistently showed no clear effect (+0.6% avg) across previous tests.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Controls Welcome Guide Copy
candidates.change: Update the home intro headline and body copy to explicitly instruct users on how to access the pet tray icon and hide/show controls.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported user confusion regarding how to hide or interact with the pet once onboarding finished.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Look for your pet walking on your screen or find the pet icon in your system tray to adjust volume, toggle visibility, or open settings.

guard.reason: Updating text copy on home intro is permitted inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost copy update backed by 3 emails, but past test for finish copy showed -1.9% lift.

candidates.title: Render Stage Live Step Progress Bar
candidates.change: Display explicit step counters and estimated remaining time on the desktop render waiting screen.
candidates.why: Waiting screen has high drop-off risks during the mean 2336s wait; wait_info additions are proven effective in past rounds.

guard.reason: Displaying step counters and time estimates on the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses 38-min mean wait time with strong past confidence (4 winning tests, +1.4% avg).

candidates.title: Pet Selection Quality Assurance Badge
candidates.change: Add an interactive quality badge indicator on the pet selection stage reassuring users that their custom pet rendering is verified and cloud-backed.
candidates.why: 3 support emails cited custom pet generation errors or unexpected pet visual results.

guard.reason: Adding a visual quality assurance badge on the pet selection screen complies with all base rules.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest drop-off step (adoption) with support email backing and positive single-test precedent (+3.1%).
